title: Reproducibility archive for two agricultural-tractor virtual-prototype studies
description:
Current papers, model and algorithm source, experiment-generation scripts, declared parameter manifests, and documentation for two theoretical agricultural-tractor virtual-prototype studies: an accepted Machines manuscript and a corrected Energies author proof.

The working tree contains no frozen experiment outputs, trajectories, checkpoints, old manuscripts, or review correspondence. Main experiments can be recomputed from source in an empty external workspace; this archive does not claim to provide the complete frozen-data deposit or automatic regeneration of every figure.

There are no vehicle, bench, or target-component calibration data. The approximately 20% fuel case uses ideal conditions, complete future information, and a wider terminal-SOC band and is separate from the causal online protocol. The author proof is not the final published version.
